{{Quote|Heavenly Hutches!|Jaxxon|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 10">[[Star Wars (1977) 10|''Star Wars'' (1977) 10]]</ref>}}
A '''Holy Hutch''' was an exclamation used by the [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]]. It apparently referred to a sacred home of the species. During his attack against the [[Behemoth from the World Below]], Jaxxon mentioned the "heavenly hutches", when he was nearly killed by the beast. He also mentioned "the Holy Hutch" when he was captured by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] loyal to [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]].
